shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Karl… Karl! Schau dir meine Stirn an!
shots.action: Mo holding a lottery ticket with shaking hands, his forehead display jumping from 12,40 € to 48.000.000 €, Karl behind the counter bored
shots.motion: Mo's forehead numbers spin wildly upward, he stares at the ticket and shouts

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Achtundvierzig Millionen.
shots.action: Karl chewing gum, looking at Mo's forehead completely unimpressed
shots.motion: he blinks slowly and speaks without moving his face

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: ACHTUNDVIERZIG MILLIONEN!
shots.action: Mo screaming with joy, hands on his head, forehead display 48.000.000 € glowing
shots.motion: he jumps and screams, snacks fall off the shelf behind him

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Hab ich doch gesagt.
shots.action: Karl leaning on the counter
shots.motion: he shrugs one shoulder

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Ich hab im Lotto gewonnen, Bruder! Ich bin reich!
shots.action: Mo hugging Karl over the counter, Karl not hugging back
shots.motion: Mo squeezes Karl, Karl stays stiff like a board

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Glückwunsch. Zahlst du jetzt deine Cola?
shots.action: Karl holding up a single can of cola
shots.motion: he slides the cola can forward

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Ich kauf dir den ganzen Kiosk!
shots.action: Mo pointing around the kiosk with both arms wide
shots.motion: he spins around pointing at everything

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Der Kiosk gehört mir nicht.
shots.action: Karl deadpan
shots.motion: he says it flatly

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Warum stehen so viele Leute vor meiner Tür?
shots.action: Mo and Karl staring at a huge crowd of fruit-headed people with phones in front of the run-down apartment block
shots.motion: slow push-in on the crowd, people wave and film

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Rate mal.
shots.action: Karl with hands in his hoodie pockets
shots.motion: he glances sideways at Mo

shots.speaker: KALLE
shots.text: Mo, mein Junge! Dein Lieblingsonkel ist da!
shots.action: the coconut uncle pushes through the crowd with open arms toward Mo
shots.motion: he runs in with open arms and a huge gold-tooth grin

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Ich hab keinen Onkel.
shots.action: Mo confused, leaning back
shots.motion: he leans away suspiciously

shots.speaker: KALLE
shots.text: Jetzt schon.
shots.action: the coconut uncle winking, forehead display -250.000 € glowing
shots.motion: he winks and grins

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Schau auf seine Stirn. Minus zweihundertfünfzigtausend.
shots.action: Karl pointing at the uncle's forehead display -250.000 €
shots.motion: he points lazily at the uncle's forehead, the uncle covers it with his hand

shots.speaker: JESSY
shots.text: Mo… ich hab dich nie vergessen.
shots.action: the cherry ex-girlfriend steps out of the crowd and touches Mo's chest sweetly
shots.motion: she flutters her eyelashes and smiles

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Jessy? Du hast per Sprachnachricht mit mir Schluss gemacht!
shots.action: Mo pointing at Jessy, shocked
shots.motion: he steps back and points at her

shots.speaker: JESSY
shots.text: Ich war jung.
shots.action: Jessy tilting her head innocently
shots.motion: she twirls her leaf like a strand of hair

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Minus vierzehntausend.
shots.camera: close-up on Jessy's forehead display -14.000 €, Karl in the foreground
shots.action: Karl reading Jessy's forehead
shots.motion: rack focus from Karl to Jessy's forehead

shots.speaker: JESSY
shots.text: Hör auf, auf meine Stirn zu gucken!
shots.action: Jessy covering her forehead with her designer bag
shots.motion: she hides her forehead angrily

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Willkommen in meinem Penthouse! Mit Pool! Im Wohnzimmer!
shots.action: Mo in his new rich outfit presenting the pool in the living room, Karl standing next to him in his kiosk apron
shots.motion: Mo spreads his arms, camera sweeps over the pool and skyline

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Warum ist der Pool im Wohnzimmer?
shots.action: Karl looking at the pool
shots.motion: he tilts his head slightly

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Weil ich es kann!
shots.action: Mo posing proudly with sunglasses
shots.motion: he puts on sunglasses dramatically

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Du kannst nicht schwimmen.
shots.action: Karl deadpan
shots.motion: no reaction at all

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: …Dann kauf ich mir einen Schwimmlehrer.
shots.action: Mo pausing, then pointing a finger up with an idea
shots.motion: he freezes, then raises a finger

shots.speaker: LILA
shots.text: Herr Mo. Doktor Lila, Vermögensberater. Ihr Geld verdient eine Familie.
shots.action: the eggplant banker shakes Mo's hand at the party, perfect smile
shots.motion: he shakes Mo's hand too long, smile sparkles

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Mein Geld hat jetzt eine Familie?
shots.action: Mo confused but flattered
shots.motion: he scratches his head and smiles

shots.speaker: LILA
shots.text: Unterschreiben Sie hier, und Ihre Millionen arbeiten für Sie.
shots.action: the banker opening a thick contract folder and holding out a gold pen
shots.motion: he clicks the gold pen and slides the folder

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Lies das erst.
shots.action: Karl in his kiosk apron among party guests, holding a cola
shots.motion: he leans in to Mo

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Bro, das sind dreißig Seiten. Mach du den Papierkram, ich hab Party.
shots.action: Mo pushing the folder into Karl's hands and dancing away
shots.motion: he hands Karl the folder and dances off

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: …Okay.
shots.action: Karl holding the folder, looking at the banker suspiciously
shots.motion: he slowly looks from the folder to the banker

shots.speaker: JESSY
shots.text: Schatz, unterschreib einfach diese eine Seite. Für uns.
shots.action: Jessy pulls a single page from her handbag and hands Mo the gold pen
shots.motion: she whispers into his ear and gives him the pen

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Für uns?
shots.action: Mo blushing, signing the page
shots.motion: he signs with a big flourish

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Mo! Nein! Nicht!
shots.action: Karl dropping his cola across the room
shots.motion: his cola can falls in slow motion

shots.speaker: LILA
shots.text: Vielen Dank, Herr Mo. Es war mir ein Vergnügen.
shots.action: the banker taking the signed page from Jessy, both smiling at each other
shots.motion: they exchange a quick secret glance and smile

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Karl… warum zählt meine Stirn rückwärts?!
shots.camera: extreme close-up on Mo's forehead display counting down from 48.000.000 €
shots.action: Mo panicking, eyes huge
shots.motion: the forehead numbers rapidly count down, party lights flicker

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Weil du gerade alles überschrieben hast an…
shots.action: Karl looking dead serious for the first time
shots.motion: slow push-in, the music cuts
